schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates land together. One PR a week that CI either passes or does not beats twenty that nobody reviews.
Majors stay separate: they are the ones that need a human to read a changelog.
Pin container images by digest. A tag can be repointed at different bytes; a digest cannot, which is the whole point of a reproducible build.
GitHub Actions are code that runs with repository credentials. Pin to a commit SHA so a compromised tag cannot silently change what executes.
